Title: NETMESSAGE:Nih (radio):\nIntelligence reports a group of tanks supported by footsoldiers ahead of our position.
Translation: Nih (radio):\n情报报告，我方阵地前方有一支由步兵支援的坦克部队。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Trempler (radio):\nThey will tremble before my temple!
Translation: Trempler (radio):\n他们将在我的圣殿前颤抖！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Nih (radio):\nLet's get rid of the door. HQ, requesting artillery fire at these coordinates!
Translation: Nih (radio):\n我们先把这扇门处理掉。总部，请求对这些坐标进行炮火打击！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Nih (radio):\nGood luck team, we'll be taking the surface!
Translation: Nih (radio):\n祝大家好运，我们将占领地面！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nThe jet attack seems to have caused the desired damage. Your next objective is to\ndestroy the enemy air support planes while they are still inside their hangar.
Translation: Sven Viking (radio):\n喷气机攻击似乎已经造成了预期的破坏。你的下一个目标是\n摧毁敌方空中支援飞机，趁它们还在机库内。
